skills.name: unslop-tests
skills.invariant: A test that cannot fail proves nothing. No tautological assertions, no mock-only tests, no hardcoded waits, no retries used as a fix. Every new or edited test must be seen failing against the broken behaviour before it counts as passing.

skills.name: unslop-answers
skills.invariant: Every claim is evidenced, quantified, or marked unverified. Name the command and paste what it printed, or write 'changed, not run'. Numbers carry their denominator and window. Findings carry a file:line. What was skipped is stated in the first two lines.

skills.name: communicating-quality-findings
skills.invariant: Result and blocker in the first two lines. One decision per report. Findings ordered by stated cost. The full artifact goes to a file under .qa/, at most five decision items in the message. Brevity never removes an evidence rung.
